settings.visualStyle: AI-generated historical reenactment styled as September 1939 black-and-white 35mm wartime field-newsreel footage. Period-correct Polish campaign roads, villages, uniforms, steel helmets, bolt-action rifles, leather field gear, trucks and light armored vehicles. Moderate readable film grain, fine scratches, dust, gate weave, frame jitter, soft period optics, exposure breathing and restrained motion blur. Non-graphic combat only. No modern objects, HDR, drone, gimbal, glossy lighting, FPS framing or heroic glamour.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds. A real human war correspondent is physically embedded with the infantry and operates a heavy hand/shoulder-held period field camera from inside the same danger zone. The cameraman never has omniscient access: he stays roughly 1–4 meters from nearby soldiers, is blocked by bodies, walls, foliage and vehicles, reacts slightly late, ducks when soldiers duck, loses framing during sudden impacts, briefly soft-focuses while moving, and settles only after reaching cover. No dialogue, narrator, subtitles or music. Diegetic battlefield sound only.
settings.customVisualStyle: Human-operated 1939 field-camera realism: imperfect horizon, shoulder/chest height, reactive pans, hesitant reframing, partial occlusion by nearby soldiers, mud or dust near the lens, tiny accidental tilts, imperfect focus pulls and brief camera settling after running or shell bursts. The operator cannot float, teleport, lead action perfectly or film from unsafe impossible positions.

archivalLookLock.presentation: AI-generated historical reenactment with archival-style visual treatment; never claim the generated footage is genuine archive film.
archivalLookLock.audioPolicy: No music, no narration and no intelligible dialogue. Diegetic battlefield sound only.

movie.plotDetails: A fictional composite frontline rifleman serves only as continuity anchor. The camera is an equally important unseen character: a vulnerable wartime correspondent physically following the section through the same mud, cover and danger.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create a two-minute AI-generated historical reenactment of the 1939 invasion of Poland as if recorded by a human wartime cameraman embedded directly with one infantry section. The cameraman is physically present, never omniscient, and must obey terrain, cover, line of sight and human reaction time. Follow a muddy dawn march, smoke sighting, field deployment, first contact, short village fight, hedgerow flank, light armored support, aftermath and continued movement. Black-and-white 35mm wartime newsreel texture. No dialogue, narration or music. Non-graphic. Period-correct equipment only.
movie.storySummary: A rifleman marches along a muddy Polish country road. Smoke ahead forces the section into wet fields. First contact at a village edge becomes a brief confused fight through walls, lanes and hedges. Light armor moves up, the section passes a wounded comrade, reforms and continues toward more smoke on the horizon. Every scene is observed from a nearby human cameraman who shares the same physical danger.
movie.genreDetailPrompt: Archival-style AI reenactment, clearly not genuine historical footage.
movie.storyTitle: WWII FRONTLINE FOOTAGE EP01 — Poland 1939: The War Begins

scenes.title: Mud Road at Dawn
scenes.description: A long infantry column moves through pale dawn mist on a muddy road.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman walks mid-column while trucks crawl through the same ruts behind.
scenes.imageDescription: September 1939 Polish countryside, deeply rutted road, wet grass, telegraph poles, long infantry column, period steel helmets, bolt-action rifles, trucks, pure black-and-white 35mm newsreel texture.
scenes.videoPrompt: The cameraman physically walks in the mud beside the column at shoulder height, 1-2 meters from the men. Human footstep bounce, tiny horizon drift, soldiers occasionally block the lens, brief imperfect refocus from muddy boots to the rifleman. No smooth gimbal. Audio: boots, gear, truck engines, wind, distant aircraft. No music or speech.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Cameraman remains beside the same column with trucks behind and smoke-free horizon ahead.

scenes.title: Smoke Beyond the Fields
scenes.description: The column slows when smoke appears over a distant village.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman stops and turns toward the smoke while the line compresses behind him.
scenes.imageDescription: Same road and column, distant Polish village with one smoke plume, black-and-white field-film grain and soft optics.
scenes.videoPrompt: The operator stops one beat late, camera dipping from his final step, then raises toward the rifleman and performs an imperfect hand pan to the smoke. A shoulder of another soldier briefly enters frame. Audio: boots stopping, engines idling, wind, distant rumble.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera ends on smoke while troops begin preparing to leave the road.

scenes.title: Off the Road
scenes.description: The section deploys along a wet hedgerow.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman steps into wet grass and follows the hedge with wider spacing.
scenes.imageDescription: Wet autumn grass, hedge roots, drainage ditch, same muddy rifleman and village roofs ahead, 1939 gear.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman squeezes through the hedge behind the men, leaves and wet grass partially covering the lens. Low uneven side-step movement, brief focus loss on foliage, then recover on the rifleman. Audio: grass, mud, gear, one far rifle crack.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator reaches hedge-side ditch behind the section.

scenes.title: First Contact
scenes.description: Incoming rifle fire drives the section behind a low stone wall.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman and two comrades drop behind the wall as plaster chips farther ahead.
scenes.imageDescription: Village-edge stone wall, white plaster house, wet road, smoke, non-graphic impact debris, black-and-white grain.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera operator is standing just behind the soldiers when shots crack. He flinches and drops hard with them, frame briefly tilting toward ground and going soft before settling behind the wall. Wall blocks lower half of view. Audio: sharp rifle cracks, stone chips, breath, distant engine.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Cameraman crouches behind same wall shoulder-to-shoulder with troops.

scenes.title: Answer From the Wall
scenes.description: The section returns controlled fire down the lane.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman rises briefly, fires several bolt-action shots, then lowers again.
scenes.imageDescription: Same wall and village geometry, rifle offset from center, muzzle smoke, distant lane, newsreel grain.
scenes.videoPrompt: The cameraman stays behind cover and only leans enough to see over the rifleman’s shoulder. View is partly blocked by helmet and wall; small recoil twitch and late refocus. He immediately ducks when the soldier ducks. Audio: distinct rifle reports, bolt cycling, echoes, no continuous automatic fire.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera remains low while section shifts toward lane crossing.

scenes.title: Across the Lane
scenes.description: The section makes a short exposed crossing to a damaged house.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman runs across wet cobblestones and presses against a wall.
scenes.imageDescription: Narrow village lane, wet cobbles, broken cart, damaged plaster, smoke, same soldier running low.
scenes.videoPrompt: The cameraman waits behind the previous corner, then follows a fraction late in one short sprint. Heavy human bounce, momentary framing of boots and wall, abrupt stop as he collides lightly into cover behind the troops. Audio: boots, gear, distant cracks, plaster falling.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator is pressed against the same house wall behind the squad.

scenes.title: Pinned in the Courtyard
scenes.description: A burst of fire halts movement while a support team prepares its weapon.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman crouches behind timber while support crew works nearby.
scenes.imageDescription: Farm courtyard, stacked timber, trough, smoke haze, period support weapon, no enemy visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman remains crouched behind timber at human eye level, unable to see the full courtyard. Nearby soldier’s back repeatedly occludes the view. One nervous hand-operated reframe toward the support weapon, then stillness. Audio: intermittent shots, wood splinters, metal setup sounds, breath.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera stays behind timber until the small flanking group departs.

scenes.title: Flank Through the Grass
scenes.description: A small group crawls along the field-side hedge.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman crawls beside the ditch using hedge cover.
scenes.imageDescription: Wet grass, muddy ditch, same rifleman prone, village roofline partly hidden, black-and-white field film.
scenes.videoPrompt: The cameraman crawls too, lens only 40-70 cm above wet ground. Grass repeatedly brushes across frame, mud splashes near lens edge, breathing becomes audible. No impossible clean side view. Audio: wet soil, fabric, grass, distant fire.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator reaches the same ditch immediately behind the rifleman.

scenes.title: Fire Across the Ditch
scenes.description: The flanking group fires from the shallow ditch.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman fires from the ditch lip while distant soil kicks up.
scenes.imageDescription: Muddy drainage ditch, smoke over field, prone troops, no visible close enemy, non-graphic.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera remains inside the ditch beside the men, so the ditch edge blocks lower frame. Operator lifts only slightly with the rifleman, catches two or three shots, then ducks with him after distant impacts. Slight lens dirt remains from Scene 08. Audio: controlled rifle fire, wind, distant answering shots.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera drops back below ditch lip with troops.

scenes.title: Armor Moves Up
scenes.description: Light armored vehicles pass the infantry toward the village.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman watches period light armor rumble through mud.
scenes.imageDescription: Churned muddy road, tired infantry aside, early-war light armored vehicles moving toward smoke.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman stands at road edge among soldiers, vehicle passing very close causes natural pan and vibration. Dust/mud from wheels momentarily hazes lower lens. Operator does not walk ahead of vehicle. Audio: engines, tracks, mud, gear.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Vehicles move ahead while camera remains with infantry.

scenes.title: Quiet Street
scenes.description: The village lane is quieter, filled with smoke and debris.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman walks slowly through the lane checking windows and doors.
scenes.imageDescription: Cracked plaster, broken glass, damaged cart, thinner smoke, exhausted infantry, no graphic casualties.
scenes.videoPrompt: The operator follows a few steps behind, carefully stepping over rubble. Camera dips when he watches footing, then rises to the rifleman; a doorway briefly blocks the right edge. Audio: glass under boots, small fire, distant artillery, wind.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera remains behind the rifleman in same lane.

scenes.title: A Wounded Comrade
scenes.description: Two soldiers help a conscious wounded comrade away.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman lowers his weapon slightly as the trio passes.
scenes.imageDescription: Non-graphic wounded soldier supported under both arms, same street, smoke, tired troops.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman notices the trio late and turns toward them with an imperfect pan, stepping aside so they can pass close to lens. One supporting soldier briefly fills most of frame. No staged push-in. Audio: strained breathing, slow boots, gear, distant guns.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera turns back toward lead soldier after trio exits frame.

scenes.title: Reform the Column
scenes.description: The section regroups beside the road and prepares to move again.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman tightens his pack and falls back into line.
scenes.imageDescription: Late-morning muddy roadside regrouping, dirtier troops, village smoke behind, vehicles ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator stands among the men, close on muddy hands and straps, then backs awkwardly one step as the column starts moving. Small framing correction rather than polished pull-back. Audio: buckle, cloth, boots restarting, engines ahead.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Cameraman walks again beside the reformed column.

scenes.title: More Smoke on the Horizon
scenes.description: Several smoke columns become visible across distant countryside.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman pauses at field edge and looks toward the horizon.
scenes.imageDescription: Wide autumn fields, multiple distant smoke columns, tired rifleman foreground, no nearby firing.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman stops beside him, shoulder breathing creating tiny vertical drift. Slow human pan to horizon, slight overshoot and correction, then hold. Audio: wind, faint engines, very distant artillery.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera ends facing the next road direction with smoke ahead.

scenes.title: The War Has Begun
scenes.description: The column disappears toward the next horizon.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman becomes one small figure among the marching line.
scenes.imageDescription: Long muddy road receding into haze, infantry column moving away, smoke ahead and behind, no victory gesture.
scenes.videoPrompt: The cameraman stops walking from fatigue while the column continues away. Camera remains at human shoulder height with subtle breathing sway and imperfect horizon; no dramatic crane or pull-back. Audio: diminishing boots, engines, wind and distant artillery only.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Final archival-style frame holds on receding column.
